extDescription.message: Pick any color from a page or your screen, identify fonts on hover, check contrast and export palettes. Fast and keyboard-friendly.

fonts_likely_badge.description: Side panel, Fonts tab: small badge next to a font name when the font is a best guess. One short word.

fonts_likely_title.message: Best guess based on fonts installed on the device
fonts_likely_title.description: Side panel, Fonts tab: tooltip on the 'Likely' badge.

fonts_specimen_pangram.message: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
fonts_specimen_pangram.description: Side panel, Fonts tab: sample sentence rendered in the inspected font. Use a short sentence in your language that shows many letters (a pangram if one exists). One line, about 45 characters.

fonts_fact_size.description: Side panel, font card: label for the font size value (e.g. 16px). One short word.

fonts_fact_weight.description: Side panel, font card: label for the font weight value (e.g. 400 Regular). One short word.

fonts_fact_line_height.description: Side panel, font card: label for the line-height value. Short.

fonts_fact_spacing.description: Side panel, font card: label for the letter-spacing value. One short word.

fonts_spacing_normal.description: Side panel, font card: letter-spacing value when the page uses the default spacing.

fonts_copy_css.description: Side panel, font card: button that copies the font's CSS declarations. Short button text.

fonts_copied_css.description: Toast shown after the font's CSS was copied to the clipboard.

fonts_save_font.description: Side panel, font card: tooltip and screen-reader label of the bookmark icon button.

fonts_add_favourite.description: Side panel, font card: tooltip and screen-reader label of the heart icon button when the font is not a favourite.

fonts_remove_favourite.description: Side panel, font card: tooltip and screen-reader label of the heart icon button when the font is a favourite.

fonts_remove.description: Side panel, font card: tooltip and screen-reader label of the trash icon button that removes the font from the list.

fonts_eyebrow_library.description: Side panel, Fonts tab: small uppercase label above the section heading. Short.

fonts_heading_recent.description: Side panel, Fonts tab: heading when the list of recently inspected fonts is shown.

fonts_heading_saved.description: Side panel, Fonts tab: heading when the list of saved fonts is shown.

fonts_search_label.description: Side panel, Fonts tab: screen-reader label of the search field.

fonts_search_placeholder.description: Side panel, Fonts tab: placeholder in the search field. Keep under about 32 characters.

fonts_list_label.description: Side panel, Fonts tab: screen-reader label of the Recent/Saved switch.

fonts_tab_recent_one.description: Side panel, Fonts tab: segmented-control option for recent fonts; {0} is how many there are. Keep short, it shares the width with the Saved option.

fonts_tab_recent_other.description: Side panel, Fonts tab: segmented-control option for recent fonts; {0} is how many there are. Keep short, it shares the width with the Saved option.

fonts_tab_saved_one.description: Side panel, Fonts tab: segmented-control option for saved fonts; {0} is how many there are. Keep short.

fonts_tab_saved_other.description: Side panel, Fonts tab: segmented-control option for saved fonts; {0} is how many there are. Keep short.

fonts_empty_search_title.description: Side panel, Fonts tab: empty-state title when the search finds nothing.

fonts_empty_search_body.message: Try a family name, source or hostname.
fonts_empty_search_body.description: Side panel, Fonts tab: empty-state hint when the search finds nothing.

fonts_empty_recent_title.description: Side panel, Fonts tab: empty-state title when no fonts have been inspected.

fonts_empty_recent_body.message: Highlight text on any page and save its font from the inspector to keep its details here.
fonts_empty_recent_body.description: Side panel, Fonts tab: empty-state explanation when no fonts have been inspected.

fonts_empty_saved_title.description: Side panel, Fonts tab: empty-state title when no fonts are saved.

fonts_empty_saved_body.message: Save a font from the inspector or from Recent to keep it for later.
fonts_empty_saved_body.description: Side panel, Fonts tab: empty-state explanation when no fonts are saved. 'Recent' refers to the Recent list option.

fonts_saved_toast.description: Toast shown after a recent font was saved.

page_loading_eyebrow.description: Side panel, Page tab: small uppercase label above the heading while the page is being scanned. Short.

page_loading_heading.description: Side panel, Page tab: heading while the page is being scanned.

page_loading_badge.description: Side panel, Page tab: small badge shown while scanning. One short word.

page_restricted_title.description: Side panel, Page tab: empty-state title on browser pages where extensions are blocked.

page_restricted_body.message: Chrome blocks extensions on browser pages and the Web Store. Switch to any website.
page_restricted_body.description: Side panel, Page tab: explanation on browser pages where extensions are blocked. 'Web Store' is the Chrome Web Store.

page_unreadable_title.message: Pickit could not read this page
page_unreadable_title.description: Side panel, Page tab: empty-state title when the scan failed although access is granted. Keep 'Pickit' untranslated.

page_unreadable_body.message: Reload the page and scan again. For local files, allow file access in the extension details.
page_unreadable_body.description: Side panel, Page tab: advice when the scan failed.

page_not_invoked_title.message: Pickit has not been invoked on this tab
page_not_invoked_title.description: Side panel, Page tab: empty-state title when Pickit has no access to the current tab yet. Keep 'Pickit' untranslated.

page_not_invoked_body.message: For your privacy, Pickit only reads a page after you invoke it there. Click the Pickit toolbar icon on this tab and scan again, or allow access to all sites so the side panel can scan any page.
page_not_invoked_body.description: Side panel, Page tab: explanation of why the page cannot be read yet. Keep 'Pickit' untranslated.

page_scan_again.description: Side panel, Page tab: button that retries the page scan. Short button text.

page_allow_all_sites.description: Side panel, Page tab: button that asks Chrome for permission to read every site. Short button text.

page_default_palette_name.description: Default name of a palette saved from a page scan when the page has no hostname.

page_saved_as_palette.description: Toast shown after the page colours were saved as a palette.

page_style_guide_downloaded.description: Toast shown after the style-guide image was downloaded.

page_current_eyebrow.description: Side panel, Page tab: small uppercase label above the page hostname. Short.

page_this_page.description: Side panel, Page tab: shown in place of the hostname when the page has none (e.g. a local file).

page_rescan.description: Side panel, Page tab: small button that scans the page again. One short word.

page_fingerprint_heading.description: Side panel, Page tab: heading above the bar showing the page's colours by how much each is used.

page_fingerprint_hint.description: Side panel, Page tab: hint next to the colour fingerprint heading. Keep short.

page_copied_colour.description: Toast shown after a colour was copied from the colour fingerprint bar.

page_style_guide_button.description: Side panel, Page tab: button that downloads the page's colours and fonts as a PNG image. Keep 'PNG'.

page_copy_tokens.description: Side panel, Page tab: button that copies the page's colours as CSS custom properties (design tokens). Short button text.

page_copied_css_variables.description: Toast shown after the page colours were copied as CSS variables.

page_palette_eyebrow.description: Side panel, Page tab: small uppercase label above the colour list heading. Short.

page_colours_heading_one.description: Side panel, Page tab: heading of the colour list; {0} is the number of colours found.

page_colours_heading_other.description: Side panel, Page tab: heading of the colour list; {0} is the number of colours found.

page_save_as_palette.description: Side panel, Page tab: small button that saves the top colours as a palette.

page_role_label.description: Side panel, Page tab: screen-reader label of the filter that shows colours by where they are used.

page_role_all.description: Side panel, Page tab: colour-role filter option showing every colour. Four options share one row, keep very short.

page_role_text.description: Side panel, Page tab: colour-role filter option for text colours. Keep very short.

page_role_background.description: Side panel, Page tab: colour-role filter option for background colours. Keep very short.

page_role_border.description: Side panel, Page tab: colour-role filter option for border colours. Keep very short.

page_no_colours_in_role.message: No colours used in this role.
page_no_colours_in_role.description: Side panel, Page tab: shown when the selected colour-role filter has no colours.

page_copy_value.description: Side panel, Page tab: screen-reader label of a colour row; {0} is the colour value, e.g. #5548E0.

page_uses_count_one.description: Side panel, Page tab: how many times a colour or font is used on the page; {0} is the count. Very short.

page_uses_count_other.description: Side panel, Page tab: how many times a colour or font is used on the page; {0} is the count. Very short.

page_type_eyebrow.description: Side panel, Page tab: small uppercase label above the typography heading. Short.

page_typography_heading_one.description: Side panel, Page tab: heading of the font list; {0} is the number of font families found.

page_typography_heading_other.description: Side panel, Page tab: heading of the font list; {0} is the number of font families found.

page_font_likely.description: Side panel, Page tab: badge next to a font name when the font is a best guess. One short word.

page_view_on_google_fonts.description: Side panel, Page tab: link to the font's Google Fonts page. Keep 'Google Fonts' untranslated.

page_more_sizes_one.description: Side panel, Page tab: chip after the first 10 font sizes; {0} is how many more sizes are not shown. Very short.

page_more_sizes_other.description: Side panel, Page tab: chip after the first 10 font sizes; {0} is how many more sizes are not shown. Very short.

page_no_text_found.message: No text was found on this page.
page_no_text_found.description: Side panel, Page tab: shown when the scan found no fonts.

page_truncated_notice_one.message: This is a large page, so only the first {0} element was read.
page_truncated_notice_one.description: Side panel, Page tab: note when the scan stopped early; {0} is the number of elements read (6,000).

page_truncated_notice_other.message: This is a large page, so only the first {0} elements were read.
page_truncated_notice_other.description: Side panel, Page tab: note when the scan stopped early; {0} is the number of elements read (6,000).

palettes_name_label.description: Side panel, Palettes tab: screen-reader label of the editable palette name field.

palettes_colour_count_one.description: Side panel, Palettes tab: number of colours in a palette, under its name.

palettes_colour_count_other.description: Side panel, Palettes tab: number of colours in a palette, under its name.

palettes_delete_confirm.description: Side panel, Palettes tab: button that confirms deleting a palette. Short button text.

palettes_delete_cancel.description: Side panel, Palettes tab: button that cancels deleting a palette. Short button text.

palettes_delete_palette.description: Side panel, Palettes tab: tooltip and screen-reader label of the trash icon button.

palettes_empty_ribbon.message: Add a colour below or from the Colours tab.
palettes_empty_ribbon.description: Side panel, Palettes tab: shown in place of the swatches when a palette is empty. 'Colours tab' is the side panel's Colours tab.

palettes_swatches_label.description: Side panel, Palettes tab: screen-reader label of a palette's row of swatches; {0} is the palette name.

palettes_swatch_title.message: {0} · click to copy, drag to reorder, Delete to remove
palettes_swatch_title.description: Side panel, Palettes tab: tooltip on a swatch; {0} is the colour value. 'Delete' is the keyboard key.

palettes_swatch_aria.message: {0}. Enter copies, Delete removes, Alt plus arrow keys reorder.
palettes_swatch_aria.description: Side panel, Palettes tab: screen-reader label of a swatch; {0} is the colour value. Enter, Delete and Alt are keyboard keys.

palettes_swatch_hint.message: Drag to reorder · Alt + ←/→ to move · Delete to remove
palettes_swatch_hint.description: Side panel, Palettes tab: hint under the swatches. Alt and Delete are keyboard keys. Keep short, one line.

palettes_add_placeholder.description: Side panel, Palettes tab: placeholder in the field for adding a colour. Only translate 'or'; keep the colour examples.

palettes_add_label.description: Side panel, Palettes tab: screen-reader label of the field for adding a colour.

palettes_add_button.description: Side panel, Palettes tab: button that adds the typed colour to the palette. One short word.

palettes_export_format_label.description: Side panel, Palettes tab: screen-reader label of the export format dropdown.

palettes_copy_button.description: Side panel, Palettes tab: small button that copies the palette export code. One short word.

palettes_copied_export.description: Toast shown after the palette export code was copied.

palettes_file_button.description: Side panel, Palettes tab: small button that downloads the palette export as a file. One short word.

palettes_downloaded_palette.description: Toast shown after a palette was downloaded; {0} is the palette name.

palettes_default_name.description: Default name of a new palette; {0} is its number, e.g. 'Palette 3'.

palettes_heading.description: Side panel, Palettes tab: section heading, followed by the number of palettes.

palettes_vision_label.message: Preview palettes as seen with a colour-vision deficiency
palettes_vision_label.description: Side panel, Palettes tab: screen-reader label of the colour-vision simulation dropdown.

palettes_vision_title.message: Check that palette colours stay distinguishable
palettes_vision_title.description: Side panel, Palettes tab: tooltip on the colour-vision simulation dropdown.

palettes_vision_typical.description: Side panel, Palettes tab: dropdown option that shows colours without simulation. Short.

palettes_empty_title.description: Side panel, Palettes tab: empty-state title.

palettes_empty_body.message: Group colours into a palette, then export them as CSS variables, SCSS, Tailwind, design tokens, JSON or SVG.
palettes_empty_body.description: Side panel, Palettes tab: empty-state explanation. Keep CSS, SCSS, Tailwind, JSON and SVG untranslated.

palettes_new_palette.description: Side panel, Palettes tab: button that creates a palette. Short button text.

palettes_all_colours_heading.description: Side panel, Palettes tab: heading above the bar of every colour across all palettes.

palettes_export_all.description: Side panel, Palettes tab: small button that downloads every palette colour as a CSS file. Short.

palettes_downloaded_all.description: Toast shown after all palette colours were downloaded.

palettes_copied_colour.description: Toast shown after a colour was copied from the All colours bar.

ui_copied_value.description: Toast shown after something was copied; {0} is the copied text, usually a colour value like #5548E0.

ui_copy_failed.description: Toast shown when copying to the clipboard failed.

ui_colorbar_label.description: Screen-reader label of the colour bar showing colours by share of use.

ui_colorbar_segment_title.description: Tooltip on one segment of the colour bar; {0} is the colour value, {1} is its share of uses as a whole number. Adjust the percent sign placement for your language.

ui_colorbar_segment_aria.description: Screen-reader label of one segment of the colour bar; {0} is the colour value, {1} is its share of uses as a whole number.

ui_copy_row_sr.description: Screen-reader text of a button that copies a colour value; {0} is the format name (HEX, RGB, HSL, OKLCH), {1} is the value.

ui_search_placeholder.description: Default placeholder in search fields. Short.

ui_search_clear.description: Screen-reader label of the button that empties a search field.

cmd_default_label.description: Command menu: default button text and dialog title. Short.

cmd_trigger_compact_label.description: Command menu: screen-reader label of the compact trigger button; {0} is the menu name (e.g. Commands), {1} is the keyboard shortcut (e.g. Alt K).

cmd_close_label.description: Command menu: screen-reader label of the close button.

cmd_list_label.description: Command menu: screen-reader label of the list of commands; {0} is the menu name (e.g. Commands).

cmd_empty.description: Command menu: shown when there are no commands.

cmd_footer_navigate.description: Command menu footer: follows the up/down arrow key icons. One short lowercase word.

cmd_footer_run.description: Command menu footer: follows the Enter key icon. One short lowercase word.

cmd_footer_close.description: Command menu footer: follows the Esc key. One short lowercase word.

styleguide_default_title.description: Exported style-guide PNG: title drawn at the top when the page has no hostname.

styleguide_colours_heading.description: Exported style-guide PNG: section heading, drawn in uppercase.

styleguide_typography_heading.description: Exported style-guide PNG: section heading, drawn in uppercase.

styleguide_font_details.description: Exported style-guide PNG: line under each font name; {0} is where the font comes from (e.g. Google Fonts), {1} a list of weights (400, 700), {2} a list of sizes (16px  24px). Keep the wide spacing around the dots. One line on a 1,072px-wide canvas.

styleguide_footer.description: Exported style-guide PNG: footer credit; {0} is the product name Pickit.

export_format_tokens.description: Export format dropdown: option for the W3C design tokens JSON format. One short word; other options are CSS, SCSS, Tailwind, JSON, SVG.

overlay_hint_bar_label.description: Screen-reader label for the floating shortcut bar shown at the bottom of the web page while a picker tool is active.

overlay_key_click.description: Shown as a key cap in the colour picker's shortcut bar: the mouse action 'click'. One short word; the bar is narrow.

overlay_key_shift_click.description: Key cap in the colour picker's shortcut bar: holding Shift while clicking. Keep 'Shift' as the key name; translate only 'Click'. Very short.

overlay_hint_copy_colour.description: Shortcut bar label next to the 'Click' key: clicking copies the colour under the cursor. 1-2 words; the bar is narrow.

overlay_hint_pick_several.description: Shortcut bar label next to 'Shift+Click': pick a colour and keep the picker open to pick more. 1-2 words.

overlay_hint_pick_from_screen.description: Shortcut bar label next to the 'S' key: opens the system eyedropper to pick a colour anywhere on screen, outside the browser. 1-3 words.

overlay_hint_cancel.description: Shortcut bar label next to the 'Esc' key: closes the colour picker. One word.

overlay_toast_cannot_read_page.description: Toast title when the colour picker cannot take a screenshot of the tab (e.g. permission lost). Keep 'Pickit' untranslated. Short; toasts are narrow.

overlay_toast_cannot_read_page_sub.message: Click the toolbar icon and try again
overlay_toast_cannot_read_page_sub.description: Second line of the toast above: tells the user to click Pickit's icon in the browser toolbar and retry. Short.

overlay_toast_capture_failed.description: Toast title when taking the screenshot the colour picker samples from failed unexpectedly. Short.

overlay_toast_try_again.description: Second line of the 'Could not capture the page' toast. 1-2 words.

overlay_toast_copied.description: Toast after picking a colour and copying it. {0} is the colour value, e.g. #1A2B3C or rgb(26, 43, 60). Short.

overlay_toast_saved.description: Toast after picking a colour when copying to the clipboard failed but the colour was saved to the history. {0} is the colour value, e.g. #1A2B3C. Short.

overlay_font_card_label.description: Screen-reader label for the font inspector's floating card that describes the font under the cursor.

overlay_font_key_hover.description: Key cap in the font inspector's shortcut bar: moving the mouse over text. One short word; the bar is narrow.

overlay_font_key_click.description: Key cap in the font inspector's shortcut bar: the mouse action 'click'. One short word.

overlay_font_hint_inspect.description: Shortcut bar label next to 'Hover': hovering shows the font of the element under the cursor. One word.

overlay_font_hint_pin_copy.description: Shortcut bar label next to 'Click': clicking pins the font card so its values can be copied. 1-3 words.

overlay_font_hint_exit.description: Shortcut bar label next to 'Esc': closes the font inspector. One word.

overlay_font_row_size.description: Row label on the font card: font size (value like '16px'). Max ~14 characters; the card is 300px wide.

overlay_font_row_weight.description: Row label on the font card: font weight (value like '700 · Bold'). Max ~14 characters.

overlay_font_row_line_height.description: Row label on the font card: CSS line height (value like '1.5 · 24px'). Max ~14 characters.

overlay_font_row_letter_spacing.description: Row label on the font card: CSS letter spacing / tracking (value like '0.02em'). Max ~14 characters.

overlay_font_row_style.description: Row label on the font card: CSS font style (value like 'italic', shown as the CSS keyword). Max ~14 characters.

overlay_font_row_colour.description: Row label on the font card: text colour (value like '#17171F'). Max ~14 characters.

overlay_font_likely.description: Small badge next to the font family name on the font card when the font was guessed rather than confirmed. One short word.

overlay_font_likely_tooltip.message: Best guess based on fonts installed on this device
overlay_font_likely_tooltip.description: Tooltip on the 'Likely' badge: explains the font name is a best guess, measured against the fonts installed on the user's computer.

overlay_font_copy_css.description: Primary button on the pinned font card: copies the font's CSS declarations. Keep 'CSS'. Short; three buttons share a 300px row.

overlay_font_save.description: Button on the pinned font card: saves the font to the user's saved fonts in Pickit. Short; three buttons share a 300px row.

overlay_font_open_google_fonts.description: Button on the pinned font card that opens the font's page on Google Fonts in a new tab. 'Google Fonts' is a product name; keep it and the ↗ arrow.

overlay_font_footer.message: Click to pin, then copy any value
overlay_font_footer.description: Hint at the bottom of the unpinned font card: click to pin the card, then click any row to copy its value. One short line, ~40 characters.

overlay_font_toast_copied.description: Toast after clicking a row on the pinned font card. {0} is the copied value, e.g. '16px' or '#17171F'. Short.

overlay_font_toast_copied_css.description: Toast after the 'Copy CSS' button copied the font's CSS. Short.

overlay_font_toast_saved.description: Toast after the 'Save font' button saved the font to Pickit's saved fonts. Short.

font_weight_thin.description: Font weight name for weight 100, shown after the number, e.g. '100 · Thin', on the font card, popup and side panel. Use the typographic term common in your language.

font_weight_extra_light.description: Font weight name for weight 200, e.g. '200 · Extra Light'. Typographic term.

font_weight_light.description: Font weight name for weight 300, e.g. '300 · Light'. Typographic term.

font_weight_regular.description: Font weight name for weight 400, e.g. '400 · Regular'. Typographic term.

font_weight_medium.description: Font weight name for weight 500, e.g. '500 · Medium'. Typographic term.

font_weight_semi_bold.description: Font weight name for weight 600, e.g. '600 · Semi Bold'. Typographic term.

font_weight_bold.description: Font weight name for weight 700, e.g. '700 · Bold'. Typographic term.

font_weight_extra_bold.description: Font weight name for weight 800, e.g. '800 · Extra Bold'. Typographic term.

font_weight_black.description: Font weight name for weight 900 (the heaviest), e.g. '900 · Black'. Typographic term, not the colour.

font_line_height_normal.description: Line height value shown when the page uses the CSS default ('normal'), on the font card and side panel. One short word.

font_letter_spacing_normal.description: Letter spacing value shown on the font card when the page uses no extra spacing (CSS 'normal'). One short word.

font_source_browser_default.description: Shown as the font name and its source when no font in the page's list is available, so the browser's default font renders the text. Short.

font_source_installed.description: Source line under the font name: the font is installed on the user's computer rather than downloaded by the page. Short; the card is 300px wide.

font_source_web_font.description: Source line under the font name: the page downloaded the font, but where from is unknown. Short.

font_source_self_hosted.description: Source line under the font name: the website serves the font file from its own domain. Short.

font_source_hosted_on.description: Source line under the font name: the font file comes from another site. {0} is a host name, e.g. 'cdn.example.com'. Short.

panel_tab_colors.description: Side panel tab name for the colour picker and history. Very short (one word, about 10 characters).

panel_tab_fonts.description: Side panel tab name for the font inspector. Very short (one word, about 10 characters).

panel_tab_page.description: Side panel tab name for the whole-page colour and font scan. Very short (one word, about 10 characters).

panel_tab_contrast.description: Side panel tab name for the contrast checker. Very short (one word, about 10 characters).

panel_tab_palettes.description: Side panel tab name for saved colour palettes. Very short (one word, about 10 characters).

panel_tabs_aria.description: Screen-reader label for the side panel's tab bar.

panel_toast_restricted_page.message: Pickit cannot run on this page
panel_toast_restricted_page.description: Toast when the picker is started on a browser page extensions may not access (e.g. the Chrome Web Store). Keep the product name Pickit.

panel_toast_copied_colour.description: Toast after copying the selected colour to the clipboard.

panel_cmd_pick_colour.description: Command menu entry that starts the in-page colour picker.

panel_cmd_inspect_font.description: Command menu entry that starts the in-page font inspector.

panel_cmd_go_colors.description: Command menu entry that switches to the Colours tab. 'Colours' should match panel_tab_colors.

panel_cmd_go_fonts.description: Command menu entry that switches to the Fonts tab. 'Fonts' should match panel_tab_fonts.

panel_cmd_go_page.description: Command menu entry that switches to the Page tab. 'Page' should match panel_tab_page.

panel_cmd_go_contrast.description: Command menu entry that switches to the Contrast tab. 'Contrast' should match panel_tab_contrast.

panel_cmd_go_palettes.description: Command menu entry that switches to the Palettes tab. 'Palettes' should match panel_tab_palettes.

panel_cmd_copy_selected_colour.description: Command menu entry that copies the selected colour in the default format.

panel_cmd_use_light_theme.description: Command menu entry that switches the extension to the light theme.

panel_cmd_use_dark_theme.description: Command menu entry that switches the extension to the dark theme.

panel_cmd_open_settings.description: Command menu entry that opens the extension's options page.

panel_settings.description: Tooltip and screen-reader label of the gear icon button in the side panel header.

panel_context_show_in_colors.description: Tooltip on the slim selected-colour bar shown on other tabs; clicking returns to the Colours tab.

panel_context_copy_colour.description: Tooltip and screen-reader label of the copy icon button on the selected-colour bar.

panel_context_check_contrast.description: Tooltip and screen-reader label of the icon button that sends the selected colour to the contrast checker.

colors_pick_from_page.description: Main button on the Colours tab that starts the in-page picker. Also inserted into colors_empty_body. Short, fits a wide button.

colors_screen_pick.description: Button next to 'Pick from page' that picks a colour anywhere on the screen. One short word.

colors_screen_pick_title.message: Pick any pixel on your screen, even outside Chrome
colors_screen_pick_title.description: Tooltip on the Screen picker button.

colors_empty_title.description: Heading of the empty state on the Colours tab before any colour is picked.

colors_empty_body.message: Click {0}, then click anything on the page. Every colour you pick is kept here so you can copy it in any format, check its contrast and build palettes.
colors_empty_body.description: Empty-state text on the Colours tab. {0} is the button name from colors_pick_from_page.

colors_selected_aria.description: Screen-reader label for the large selected-colour card.

colors_token_match_title.description: Tooltip on the CSS variable name shown on the selected colour. {0} is a CSS custom property name such as --brand-500.

colors_favorite_add.description: Tooltip and screen-reader label of the heart button when the colour is not a favourite.

colors_favorite_remove.description: Tooltip and screen-reader label of the heart button when the colour is a favourite.

colors_copy_default_format_title.description: Tooltip on the selected colour's name and value; clicking copies it.

colors_toast_copied_colour.description: Toast after copying the selected colour to the clipboard.

colors_origin_screen.description: Shown under the selected colour when it was picked from the screen rather than a website (otherwise the site's hostname is shown).

colors_add_to_palette_aria.message: Add this colour to a palette
colors_add_to_palette_aria.description: Screen-reader label for the palette drop-down on the selected colour.

colors_add_to_palette_placeholder.description: First (placeholder) entry of the palette drop-down. Short.

colors_new_palette_option.description: Drop-down entry that creates a new palette with this colour. Keep the leading '+'.

colors_default_palette_name.description: Name given to a newly created palette. {0} is a number, e.g. 'Palette 3'.

colors_toast_added_new_palette.description: Toast after a colour is added to a newly created palette.

colors_toast_already_in_palette.description: Toast when the colour is already in the chosen palette. {0} is the palette name.

colors_toast_added_to_palette.description: Toast after a colour is added to a palette. {0} is the palette name.

colors_as_text.description: Button that opens the contrast checker with this colour as the text colour. Very short (about 10 characters).

colors_as_text_title.message: Check this colour as text in the contrast checker

colors_as_bg.description: Button that opens the contrast checker with this colour as the background. 'bg' abbreviates background. Very short (about 10 characters).

colors_as_bg_title.message: Check this colour as a background in the contrast checker

colors_history_title.description: Heading of the list of previously picked colours; a count badge follows it.

colors_clear_all_confirm_one.description: Confirmation shown before clearing colour history. {0} is the number of colours (one). Short, sits beside Clear/Cancel buttons.

colors_clear_all_confirm_other.description: Confirmation shown before clearing colour history. {0} is the number of colours. Short, sits beside Clear/Cancel buttons.

colors_clear.description: Button that clears the colour history (favourites are kept), and the button that confirms it. Short.

colors_cancel.description: Button that cancels clearing the colour history. Short.

colors_remove_selected.description: Tooltip and screen-reader label of the trash icon button in the history header.

colors_search_label.description: Screen-reader label of the history search field.

colors_search_placeholder.message: Search hex, name, site or token
colors_search_placeholder.description: Placeholder in the history search field. Keep 'hex' as the colour-format term. Fits a narrow field (about 35 characters).

colors_favorites_only_title.description: Tooltip of the heart toggle that filters history to favourites.

colors_no_favorites.message: No favourites yet. Tap the heart on a colour to keep it.
colors_no_favorites.description: Shown when the favourites filter is on and there are no favourites.

colors_no_search_match.description: Shown when the history search finds nothing.

colors_swatch_title.description: Tooltip on a history swatch. {0} is the colour value, e.g. #1A2B3C.

colors_swatch_title_favorite.description: Tooltip on a favourite history swatch. {0} is the colour value, e.g. #1A2B3C.

colors_swatch_select_aria.description: Screen-reader label of a history swatch. {0} is a hex colour.

colors_swatch_select_favorite_aria.description: Screen-reader label of a favourite history swatch. {0} is a hex colour.

colors_history_hint.message: Click to inspect · double-click to copy · favourites survive Clear
colors_history_hint.description: Hint under the history grid. 'Clear' refers to the Clear button (colors_clear).

colors_explore_aria.description: Screen-reader label of the shades/harmonies section.

colors_explore.description: Heading of the section showing shades and harmonies of the selected colour; also the label of its switch.

colors_explore_shades.description: Segmented-control option showing a lightness scale of the colour. Very short (fits about 90px).

colors_explore_harmonies.description: Segmented-control option showing colour harmonies (complementary, triadic…). Very short (fits about 90px).

colors_shade_scale_aria.description: Screen-reader label of the row of shade swatches (50-950).

colors_shade_title.description: Tooltip on a shade swatch. {0} is the shade step (e.g. 500), {1} the colour value.

colors_shade_title_nearest.description: Tooltip on the shade swatch nearest the selected colour. {0} is the shade step (e.g. 500), {1} the colour value.

colors_shade_copy_aria.description: Screen-reader label of a shade swatch. {0} is the shade step (e.g. 500), {1} the colour value.

colors_copy_scale_as.description: Label before the CSS / Tailwind / Tokens buttons that copy the whole shade scale as code.

colors_copy_scale_tokens.description: Button that copies the shade scale as design tokens JSON. One short word.

colors_toast_copied_css_variables.description: Toast after copying the shade scale as CSS custom properties.

colors_toast_copied_tailwind_scale.description: Toast after copying the shade scale as a Tailwind config. Keep 'Tailwind' (product name).

colors_toast_copied_design_tokens.description: Toast after copying the shade scale as design tokens.

harmonies_aria.description: Screen-reader label of the colour harmonies section.

harmonies_neutral_message.message: This colour is a neutral (grey, near-black or near-white), so it has no hue to build harmonies from. Pick a coloured swatch to see them.
harmonies_neutral_message.description: Shown instead of harmonies when the selected colour has no hue.

harmonies_toast_added_new_palette_one.message: Added {0} colour to a new {1} palette
harmonies_toast_added_new_palette_one.description: Toast after creating a palette from a harmony. {0} is the count (one), {1} the harmony name, e.g. Triadic.

harmonies_toast_added_new_palette_other.message: Added {0} colours to a new {1} palette
harmonies_toast_added_new_palette_other.description: Toast after creating a palette from a harmony. {0} is the count, {1} the harmony name, e.g. Triadic.

harmonies_toast_already_in_palette.message: {0} colours are already in the palette
harmonies_toast_already_in_palette.description: Toast when every colour of a harmony is already in its palette. {0} is the harmony name, e.g. Triadic.

harmonies_toast_added_to_palette_one.description: Toast after adding missing harmony colours to an existing palette. {0} is the count (one), {1} the palette/harmony name.

harmonies_toast_added_to_palette_other.description: Toast after adding missing harmony colours to an existing palette. {0} is the count, {1} the palette/harmony name.

harmonies_add_all_aria.description: Screen-reader label of the '+ Palette' button on a harmony row. {0} is the harmony name.

harmonies_add_all_title.message: Add all {0} colours to a palette
harmonies_add_all_title.description: Tooltip of the '+ Palette' button on a harmony row. {0} is the harmony name.

harmonies_add_palette_button.description: Small text button on each harmony row that saves the row as a palette. Keep the leading '+'. Very short (about 10 characters).

harmonies_strip_aria.description: Screen-reader label for a row of harmony swatches. {0} is the harmony name, e.g. Triadic.

harmonies_swatch_title.description: Tooltip on a harmony swatch. {0} is the colour value.

harmonies_swatch_title_base.description: Tooltip on the base (starting) colour swatch of a harmony. {0} is the colour value.

harmonies_swatch_copy_aria.description: Screen-reader label of a harmony swatch. {0} is the colour value, {1} the harmony name.

harmonies_swatch_copy_base_aria.description: Screen-reader label of the base swatch of a harmony. {0} is the colour value, {1} the harmony name.

harmonies_toast_copied_value.description: Toast after copying a harmony colour. {0} is the colour value.

harmonies_base_badge.description: Tiny badge on the base colour of a harmony row. Lowercase, about 4-6 characters.

harmony_complementary.description: Colour harmony name: the base colour and its opposite hue. Also used as a default palette name.

harmony_analogous.description: Colour harmony name: neighbouring hues. Also used as a default palette name.

harmony_triadic.description: Colour harmony name: three evenly spaced hues. Also used as a default palette name.

harmony_split_complement.description: Colour harmony name: the base plus the two hues beside its opposite. Also used as a default palette name.

harmony_tetradic.description: Colour harmony name: four evenly spaced hues. Also used as a default palette name.

contrast_field_text.description: Label of the text (foreground) colour field in the contrast checker. One short word.

contrast_field_background.description: Label of the background colour field in the contrast checker. One short word.

contrast_text_picker_aria.description: Screen-reader label of the native colour picker for the text colour.

contrast_background_picker_aria.description: Screen-reader label of the native colour picker for the background colour.

contrast_use_recent_as_text_aria.description: Screen-reader label of a recent-colour chip under the text field. {0} is a hex colour.

contrast_use_recent_as_background_aria.description: Screen-reader label of a recent-colour chip under the background field. {0} is a hex colour.

contrast_grade_aa_large.description: Contrast grade badge: passes WCAG AA for large text only. Keep 'AA' untranslated. Very short.

contrast_grade_fails.description: Contrast grade badge: fails WCAG AA even for large text. One short word.

contrast_simulating.description: Note on the contrast preview while a colour-vision simulation is on. {0} is a vision type name, e.g. Protanopia.

contrast_preview_large.description: Sample line in the contrast preview, shown in large type.

contrast_preview_body.message: Body text at 16px. The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
contrast_preview_body.description: Sample paragraph in the contrast preview. The second sentence is filler text; any natural sample sentence in the target language works.

contrast_apca_title.message: APCA lightness contrast, proposed for WCAG 3
contrast_apca_title.description: Tooltip on the 'APCA Lc' readout. Keep APCA and WCAG 3 untranslated.

contrast_swap.description: Tooltip and screen-reader label of the swap icon button.

contrast_apca_use.description: Line under the contrast readout. {0} is a usage hint from apca_use_* (e.g. 'Body text from 18px'). Keep APCA untranslated.

contrast_check_aa_body.description: Pass/fail row: WCAG AA for body (normal) text. Keep 'AA'. Very short.

contrast_check_aa_large.description: Pass/fail row: WCAG AA for large text. Keep 'AA'. Very short.

contrast_check_aaa_body.description: Pass/fail row: WCAG AAA for body (normal) text. Keep 'AAA'. Very short.

contrast_check_aaa_large.description: Pass/fail row: WCAG AAA for large text. Keep 'AAA'. Very short.

contrast_fixes_aria.description: Screen-reader label of the suggested colour fixes section.

contrast_fixes_title.description: Heading of the suggested fixes. {0} is the WCAG level (AA or AAA), {1} the target ratio (4.5 or 7).

contrast_fix_text.description: Suggested fix button that changes the text colour. Short.

contrast_fix_background.description: Suggested fix button that changes the background colour. Short.

contrast_vision_title.description: Heading (and screen-reader label) of the colour-vision simulation section.

contrast_vision_typical_note.description: Note beside the colour vision heading when no simulation is selected.

contrast_vision_picker_aria.description: Screen-reader label of the colour-vision button group.

contrast_vision_short_typical.description: Button in the colour-vision picker for no simulation. Five buttons share one row: keep to about 7 characters.

contrast_vision_short_protanopia.description: Abbreviation of Protanopia (red-blind) on the colour-vision picker. Keep to about 7 characters.

contrast_vision_short_deuteranopia.description: Abbreviation of Deuteranopia (green-blind) on the colour-vision picker. Keep to about 7 characters.

contrast_vision_short_tritanopia.description: Abbreviation of Tritanopia (blue-blind) on the colour-vision picker. Keep to about 7 characters.

contrast_vision_short_achromatopsia.description: Short name for Achromatopsia (no colour vision, monochrome) on the colour-vision picker. Keep to about 7 characters.

contrast_pair_aria.description: Screen-reader label of the section holding the text and background colour fields.

apca_use_body_any_size.description: What an APCA contrast value is good enough for (Lc 90+). Shown after 'APCA:'.

apca_use_body_from_18px.description: What an APCA contrast value is good enough for (Lc 75-89). Shown after 'APCA:'.

apca_use_content_from_24px.description: What an APCA contrast value is good enough for (Lc 60-74). Shown after 'APCA:'.

apca_use_headlines_large_text.description: What an APCA contrast value is good enough for (Lc 45-59). Shown after 'APCA:'.

apca_use_placeholders_non_text.description: What an APCA contrast value is good enough for (Lc 30-44). Shown after 'APCA:'.

apca_use_dividers_decoration.description: What an APCA contrast value is good enough for (Lc 15-29). Shown after 'APCA:'.

apca_use_not_readable.description: APCA contrast below Lc 15: too low for anything. Shown after 'APCA:'.

vision_protanopia_label.description: Name of a colour-vision deficiency (red-blind), used in the contrast checker and palette simulator.

vision_protanopia_note.description: Short explanation of protanopia shown beside the vision picker.

vision_deuteranopia_label.description: Name of a colour-vision deficiency (green-blind), used in the contrast checker and palette simulator.

vision_deuteranopia_note.description: Short explanation of deuteranopia shown beside the vision picker.

vision_tritanopia_label.description: Name of a colour-vision deficiency (blue-blind), used in the contrast checker and palette simulator.

vision_tritanopia_note.description: Short explanation of tritanopia shown beside the vision picker.

vision_achromatopsia_label.description: Name of total colour blindness (sees only greys), used in the contrast checker and palette simulator.

vision_achromatopsia_note.description: Short explanation of achromatopsia shown beside the vision picker.

popup_failure_restricted_title.message: Pickit cannot run on this page
popup_failure_restricted_title.description: Popup warning banner title when the current tab is a browser page or the Web Store. One short line.

popup_failure_restricted_text.message: Chrome blocks extensions on browser pages and the Web Store. Open any website and try again.
popup_failure_restricted_text.description: Popup warning banner body under popup_failure_restricted_title. Popup is about 340px wide.

popup_failure_no_access_title.message: Pickit could not reach this page
popup_failure_no_access_title.description: Popup warning banner title when the extension could not inject into the tab. One short line.

popup_failure_no_access_text.message: Reload the page and try again. For local files, allow file access in the extension details.
popup_failure_no_access_text.description: Popup warning banner body under popup_failure_no_access_title. 'extension details' is Chrome's chrome://extensions details page.

popup_failure_unknown_title.description: Popup warning banner title for an unexpected error. One short line.

popup_failure_unknown_text.message: Reload the page and try again.
popup_failure_unknown_text.description: Popup warning banner body under popup_failure_unknown_title.

popup_command_pick_colour.description: Command menu item in the popup that starts the colour picker. Short.

popup_command_inspect_font.description: Command menu item in the popup that starts the font inspector. Short.

popup_command_open_workspace.description: Command menu item in the popup that opens the side panel (the 'workspace'). Short.

popup_command_copy_latest.description: Command menu item in the popup that copies the most recently picked colour. Short.

popup_command_light_theme.description: Command menu item in the popup that switches the interface to the light theme. Short.

popup_command_dark_theme.description: Command menu item in the popup that switches the interface to the dark theme. Short.

popup_command_open_settings.description: Command menu item in the popup that opens the extension's settings page. Short.

popup_toast_copied_colour.description: Brief toast in the popup after a colour value is copied to the clipboard. Very short.

popup_open_workspace_label.description: Accessible label and tooltip for the panel icon button in the popup header that opens the side panel.

popup_settings_label.description: Accessible label and tooltip for the gear icon button in the popup header.

popup_tools_label.description: Screen-reader label for the group of tool buttons (colour picker, font inspector) in the popup.

popup_tool_pick_title.description: Title on the large colour picker tool button in the popup. Keep under about 16 characters.

popup_tool_pick_sub.description: Hint under popup_tool_pick_title on the colour picker tool button. Keep under about 18 characters.

popup_tool_font_title.description: Title on the large font inspector tool button in the popup. Keep under about 16 characters.

popup_tool_font_sub.description: Hint under popup_tool_font_title on the font inspector tool button. Keep under about 18 characters.

popup_empty_colours.message: Colours you pick appear here, ready to copy in any format.
popup_empty_colours.description: Empty-state text in the popup before any colour has been picked.

popup_latest_colour_label.description: Screen-reader label for the popup section showing the most recently picked colour.

popup_latest_copy_title.description: Tooltip on the large latest-colour card in the popup; clicking copies the colour in the format chosen in settings.

popup_origin_screen.description: Shown on the latest-colour card when the colour was picked from the screen rather than a web page. One line, truncated if long.

popup_recent_colours_label.description: Screen-reader label for the row of recent colour swatches in the popup.

popup_recent_copy_label.description: Screen-reader label for a recent colour swatch button. {0} is the colour value, e.g. #1A2B3C or rgb(26 43 60).

popup_recent_copy_title.description: Tooltip on a recent colour swatch. {0} is the colour value, e.g. #1A2B3C.

popup_latest_font_label.description: Screen-reader label for the popup row showing the most recently inspected font.

popup_font_details.description: Detail line under the latest font name in the popup. {0} is the font size in CSS pixels, {1} the weight name (e.g. Bold), {2} where the font comes from (e.g. Google Fonts). Keep 'px'.

popup_workspace_link.description: Label of the link row at the bottom of the popup that opens the side panel. Short.

popup_workspace_link_sub.description: Small hint next to popup_workspace_link listing what the side panel contains. Keep under about 28 characters.

popup_rating_title.description: Bold title of the banner in the popup asking for a Chrome Web Store rating. Pickit is the product name; do not translate.

popup_rating_text.message: A rating helps other people find it.
popup_rating_text.description: Body text of the rating banner in the popup, after popup_rating_title.

popup_rating_rate.description: Button in the rating banner that opens the Chrome Web Store review page. Pickit is the product name; do not translate. Short.

popup_rating_dismiss.description: Button in the rating banner that dismisses it. Short.

welcome_step_pick_title.description: Heading of the first step card on the welcome page shown after install.

welcome_step_pick_text.message: Open the popup or use the shortcut, then click a colour on the page. Pickit reads it without watching what you do.
welcome_step_pick_text.description: Body of the first step card on the welcome page. Pickit is the product name; do not translate.

welcome_step_font_title.description: Heading of the second step card on the welcome page.

welcome_step_font_text.message: Choose the font tool and click any text. You get its family, size, weight and colour in one small panel.
welcome_step_font_text.description: Body of the second step card on the welcome page.

welcome_step_workspace_title.message: Keep it all in the workspace
welcome_step_workspace_title.description: Heading of the third step card on the welcome page. 'Workspace' is the extension's side panel.

welcome_step_workspace_text.message: The side panel holds your colour history, fonts, palettes, contrast checker and a one-click style guide of the page.
welcome_step_workspace_text.description: Body of the third step card on the welcome page.

welcome_shortcut_label.description: Screen-reader label for a keyboard shortcut shown on a welcome step card. {0} is the key combination, e.g. Alt+Shift+C.

welcome_kicker.description: Small uppercase line above the main heading on the welcome page. Pickit is the product name; do not translate.

welcome_title_lead.description: First part of the large welcome page heading, shown in normal colour. Followed by welcome_title_accent.

welcome_title_accent.description: Second part of the large welcome page heading, shown in the accent colour after welcome_title_lead.

welcome_lead.message: Three things to know, then you are set.
welcome_lead.description: Intro line under the welcome page heading, introducing the three step cards.

welcome_tip_pin.message: Tip: click the puzzle icon in Chrome's toolbar and pin Pickit so it is always one click away.
welcome_tip_pin.description: Tip at the bottom of the welcome page. 'Puzzle icon' is Chrome's Extensions toolbar button. Pickit is the product name; do not translate.

welcome_cta.description: Primary button at the bottom of the welcome page; closes the page. Short.

access_unreachable_title.message: Pickit could not reach this page
access_unreachable_title.description: Side panel warning banner title when a picker started from the side panel failed although all-sites access is granted. Pickit is the product name.

access_unreachable_text.message: Reload the page and try again. For local files, allow file access in the extension details.
access_unreachable_text.description: Side panel warning banner body under access_unreachable_title. 'extension details' is Chrome's chrome://extensions details page.

access_allow_title.description: Side panel warning banner title when the side panel has no permission to reach the current tab. Pickit is the product name.

access_allow_text.message: The side panel cannot reach a tab on its own. Click the Pickit toolbar icon on this tab, or allow access to all sites so the side panel works everywhere.
access_allow_text.description: Side panel warning banner body under access_allow_title, explaining the two ways to grant access.

access_allow_all_sites.description: Button in the side panel access banner that requests permission for all websites. Short.

access_dismiss_label.description: Accessible label and tooltip for the close (X) icon button on the side panel access banner.

settings_theme_light.description: Settings page: theme option label, shown on a segmented button and under a preview tile. Keep under 10 characters.

settings_theme_dark.description: Settings page: theme option label, shown on a segmented button and under a preview tile. Keep under 10 characters.

settings_theme_system.description: Settings page: theme option label meaning 'follow the operating system setting'. Keep under 10 characters.

settings_shortcut_not_set.description: Settings page: shown in place of key chips when a keyboard shortcut has no keys assigned. Short.

settings_shortcut_label.description: Settings page: screen-reader label for a group of key chips. {0} is the key combination, e.g. Alt+Shift+C.

settings_count_colours_one.description: Settings page: count phrase inserted into the backup banner and restore toast. {0} is the number. Singular form.

settings_count_colours_other.description: Settings page: count phrase inserted into the backup banner and restore toast. {0} is the number. Plural form.

settings_count_fonts_one.description: Settings page: count phrase inserted into the backup banner and restore toast. {0} is the number. Singular form.

settings_count_fonts_other.description: Settings page: count phrase inserted into the backup banner and restore toast. {0} is the number. Plural form.

settings_count_palettes_one.description: Settings page: count phrase inserted into the backup banner and restore toast. {0} is the number. Singular form.

settings_count_palettes_other.description: Settings page: count phrase inserted into the backup banner and restore toast. {0} is the number. Plural form.

settings_eyebrow.description: Settings page: small uppercase label above the page heading. One or two words.

settings_heading.description: Settings page: main page heading. Pickit is the product name; do not translate it.

settings_intro.message: Tune how colours are copied, how Pickit looks and what it remembers.
settings_intro.description: Settings page: one-sentence introduction under the page heading.

settings_version_badge.description: Settings page: small badge in the header. {0} is the extension version number, e.g. 1.2.0.

settings_colours_title.description: Settings page: section heading for colour format options.

settings_colours_description.message: The format and case used whenever you copy a colour.
settings_colours_description.description: Settings page: one-line description under the Colours section heading.

settings_default_format_title.description: Settings page: setting title for choosing the default colour format (HEX, RGB, HSL, OKLCH).

settings_default_format_help.message: Used when you pick a colour and for one-click copy.
settings_default_format_help.description: Settings page: help text under the Default format setting.

settings_default_format_label.description: Settings page: screen-reader label for the default colour format button group.

settings_hex_case_title.description: Settings page: setting title (and screen-reader label) for choosing upper or lower case HEX values. HEX is a technical term; keep it.

settings_hex_case_help.message: How HEX values are written when copied.
settings_hex_case_help.description: Settings page: help text under the HEX letter case setting.

settings_history_size_title.description: Settings page: setting title (and screen-reader label) for how many picked colours are remembered.

settings_history_size_help.message: Older colours are removed once the limit is reached. Favourites are always kept.
settings_history_size_help.description: Settings page: help text under the History size setting.

settings_history_size_option_one.description: Settings page: option in the History size dropdown. {0} is the number of colours kept. Singular form.

settings_history_size_option_other.description: Settings page: option in the History size dropdown. {0} is the number of colours kept, e.g. 50. Plural form.

settings_appearance_title.description: Settings page: section heading for the theme setting.

settings_appearance_description.message: Choose the look of Pickit's windows and the on-page overlay.
settings_appearance_description.description: Settings page: one-line description under the Appearance section heading.

settings_theme_title.description: Settings page: setting title (and screen-reader label) for light/dark/system theme.

settings_theme_help.message: Applies to Pickit's own windows and the on-page overlay.
settings_theme_help.description: Settings page: help text under the Theme setting.

settings_shortcuts_title.description: Settings page: section heading for keyboard shortcuts.

settings_shortcuts_description.message: Start a picker without opening the popup.
settings_shortcuts_description.description: Settings page: one-line description under the Keyboard shortcuts section heading.

settings_shortcut_pick_colour_title.description: Settings page: name of the keyboard shortcut that starts the colour picker.

settings_shortcut_pick_colour_help.message: Opens the colour picker on the current tab.
settings_shortcut_pick_colour_help.description: Settings page: help text for the Pick a colour shortcut.

settings_shortcut_inspect_font_title.description: Settings page: name of the keyboard shortcut that starts the font inspector.

settings_shortcut_inspect_font_help.message: Opens the font inspector on the current tab.
settings_shortcut_inspect_font_help.description: Settings page: help text for the Inspect a font shortcut.

settings_change_shortcuts_title.description: Settings page: setting title next to a button that opens Chrome's shortcut page.

settings_change_shortcuts_help.message: Defaults are {0} and {1}. Chrome manages shortcuts for all extensions in one place.
settings_change_shortcuts_help.description: Settings page: help text. {0} and {1} are default key combinations, e.g. Alt+Shift+C and Alt+Shift+F.

settings_open_chrome_shortcuts.description: Settings page: button that opens Chrome's extension keyboard shortcut page. Keep short.

settings_backup_title.description: Settings page: section heading for exporting and restoring data.

settings_backup_description.message: Move your colours, fonts and palettes to another browser, or keep a copy.
settings_backup_description.description: Settings page: one-line description under the Backup section heading.

settings_export_title.description: Settings page: setting title for downloading a backup file.

settings_export_help.message: Saves everything Pickit stores as one JSON file on your device.
settings_export_help.description: Settings page: help text under Export a backup. JSON is a file format; keep it.

settings_export_button.description: Settings page: button that downloads the backup file. One word if possible.

settings_toast_backup_downloaded.description: Settings page: short confirmation toast after the backup file is downloaded.

settings_restore_title.description: Settings page: setting title for loading a backup file.

settings_restore_help.message: Replaces what is stored now with the backup's contents. Export first if you want to keep both.
settings_restore_help.description: Settings page: help text under Restore a backup.

settings_restore_confirm.description: Settings page: button that confirms restoring a backup, overwriting current data. Keep short.

settings_cancel.description: Settings page: button that cancels restoring a backup or clearing data.

settings_restore_choose_file.description: Settings page: button that opens a file picker to select a backup file. Keep short.

settings_toast_file_too_large.message: That file is too large to be a Pickit backup
settings_toast_file_too_large.description: Settings page: error toast when the chosen backup file is over 5 MB.

settings_toast_restored.description: Settings page: toast after a backup is restored. {0} is a colour count phrase (e.g. '12 colours'), {1} a font count phrase, {2} a palette count phrase.

settings_restore_banner.message: This backup has {0}, {1} and {2}. Restoring replaces everything Pickit has stored now.
settings_restore_banner.description: Settings page: warning banner before confirming a restore. {0} is a colour count phrase (e.g. '12 colours'), {1} a font count phrase, {2} a palette count phrase.

settings_privacy_title.description: Settings page: section heading for data and privacy options.

settings_privacy_description.message: Decide what Pickit can read and how long it keeps it.
settings_privacy_description.description: Settings page: one-line description under the Privacy section heading.

settings_clear_data_title.description: Settings page: setting title for deleting stored history, fonts and palettes.

settings_clear_data_help.message: Removes colour history, fonts and palettes from this device. Settings are kept.
settings_clear_data_help.description: Settings page: help text under Clear data.

settings_clear_data_button.description: Settings page: button that asks to delete stored data (a confirmation follows). Keep short.

settings_clear_data_confirm.description: Settings page: button that confirms deleting all stored data. Keep short.

settings_toast_data_cleared.description: Settings page: confirmation toast after stored data is deleted.

settings_privacy_note.message: Everything Pickit saves stays in this browser. It has no account and sends nothing to a server.
settings_privacy_note.description: Settings page: information banner in the Privacy section.

backup_imported_palette_name.description: Default name given to a palette from a backup file that has no name. Shown in the palette list. Keep under 30 characters.

backup_error_invalid_json.message: This file is not valid JSON.
backup_error_invalid_json.description: Error toast when a chosen backup file cannot be read. JSON is a file format; keep it.

backup_error_not_pickit.message: This is not a Pickit backup file.
backup_error_not_pickit.description: Error toast when a chosen file is valid JSON but not a Pickit backup. Pickit is the product name.

backup_error_newer_version.message: This backup was made by a newer version of Pickit. Update Pickit and try again.
backup_error_newer_version.description: Error toast when a backup file comes from a newer version of the extension.

ui_shortcut_title.description: Tooltip on picker buttons. {0} is the key combination, e.g. Alt+Shift+C.

ui_shortcut_none.description: Tooltip on picker buttons when no keyboard shortcut is assigned.

settings_sync_title.description: Settings: title of the switch that syncs palettes and favourite colours across the user's Chrome profiles

settings_sync_help.message: Keeps your palettes and favourite colours the same in every Chrome where you are signed in. History and fonts stay on this device.
settings_sync_help.description: Settings: help text under the sync switch

settings_sync_error_quota.message: Chrome sync storage is full, so some palettes are not syncing. Delete palettes you no longer need.
settings_sync_error_quota.description: Settings: warning when chrome.storage.sync quota is exceeded

settings_sync_error_too_large.message: One palette is too large to sync. Split it into smaller palettes.
settings_sync_error_too_large.description: Settings: warning when one palette exceeds the 8 KB per-item sync limit

settings_sync_error_unavailable.message: Sync is not available right now. Check that you are signed in to Chrome with sync turned on.
settings_sync_error_unavailable.description: Settings: warning when chrome.storage.sync cannot be reached

overlay_font_close.description: Font card in the page: label of the × button that exits the font inspector

sponsor_label.description: Sponsor credit label shown before the sponsor name (popup, side panel, settings, welcome page)

sponsor_tagline.message: Free online tools for images, video, audio and PDFs. Files stay in your browser.
sponsor_tagline.description: One-line description of the sponsor ToolEnhancer, on the settings and welcome cards

sponsor_tagline_short.message: Free tools for images, PDFs and more
sponsor_tagline_short.description: Very short description of the sponsor for a single footer line (max ~40 characters)

sponsor_cta.description: Button that opens the sponsor website

sponsor_open.description: Tooltip/accessible name for the sponsor link; {0} is the sponsor name

credits_title.description: Heading of the maker card on the welcome and settings pages

credits_made_by.description: Maker credit; {0} is the developer's name

credits_open_source.message: Pickit is open source. Report a bug, suggest a feature or follow along.
credits_open_source.description: One sentence under the maker credit inviting people to the GitHub project

credits_github.description: Link to the project source code on GitHub (product name, usually unchanged)

credits_linkedin.description: Link to the developer's LinkedIn profile (product name, usually unchanged)

credits_portfolio.description: Link to the developer's personal portfolio website
